summary: Lead research for SBDC Business Planning MVP (business-plan intake/guidance). Target Ohio SBDC network and regional SBDC centers that deliver business planning services and workshops.

leads.organization: Ohio Small Business Development Centers (State Network)
leads.fit_rationale: Statewide network providing business advising and planning; centralized planning tools could scale coaching and standardize plan outputs.

leads.organization: Ohio SBDC Client Portal / Center Locations
leads.fit_rationale: Portal lists SBDC centers and services; MVP could integrate as a planning workflow or offer embedded tools to local centers.

leads.organization: Ohio SBDC at Columbus State (Central Ohio)
leads.fit_rationale: Provides business advising and startup guidance; a business‑plan builder would complement client intake and coaching.
Offers no‑cost advising and training; planning MVP can help standardize plans and speed advisor review cycles.
Serves multiple counties with business assistance; a plan‑builder tool could extend reach and improve consistency.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Clarify user flow: idea → plan sections → validation → export/coach review.
Add structured templates (Lean Canvas, SBA-style plan, financial projections) with progress indicators.
Include SBDC branding blocks and partner logos to build trust.
Provide a ‘review-ready’ checklist for advisors (market analysis, financials, operations).
Offer export formats (PDF/Docx) and advisor comments to speed iterations.
Add examples of successful plans to guide users.
Improve CTA clarity (Start Plan / Continue Plan) and reduce cognitive load on the first step.

possible_issues: If the plan builder is not centered or has uneven margins, it can feel untrustworthy for official use.
Long-form inputs without visual grouping may look overwhelming or unfinished.
Weak hierarchy can hide the primary action and next steps.

whitelabel_potential.reason: SBDC centers are distributed and often co‑branded; a white‑label plan builder would be a strong fit.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
